contract: The facade injects the compliance-aware gate into admission, reservation validation, score launch, bound-SLOT preparation, recovery COMMIT, compliance CLOSE, and replay. Because the historical attempt module hard-codes the historical gate provenance even when a new gate is injected, the facade re-encodes each RESERVE event with the actual compliance-aware gate filename/blob before durable acknowledgement while leaving the scientific reservation payload/digest and attempt identity unchanged.
limitations: The provenance validation used deterministic injected stubs for the historical attempt module.
This run did not byte-execute the complete production sibling graph in one repository-local runtime.

The compliance auditor currently validates reservation identity/binding/COMMIT, not the RESERVE event's gate_binding field; provenance correction is therefore traceability hardening rather than a new scientific-score acceptance predicate.
